title: Panzer's Hepp-bound conjecture contradicts the Martin and c2 conjectures for phi^4 periods
description:
Three pairs of completed primitive 13-loop φ4 graphs with exactly equal Hepp bounds and different Martin sequences; in one pair the c2 invariants at p = 3 also differ. Hence Panzer's Conjecture 1.2 (equal Hepp bound iff equal period, arXiv:1908.09820) cannot hold together with Panzer–Yeats Conjecture 1.10 (equal Martin sequence iff equal period, arXiv:2304.05299), nor with Brown–Schnetz Conjecture 5 (equal periods imply equal c2, arXiv:1006.4064). Monte Carlo periods of that pair agree to 7·10-5, which does not decide between the alternatives; the c2 difference points to the Hepp-bound conjecture as the false one.

The archive contains independent verification code (exact Hepp bounds modulo primes with a Chinese remainder bound, Martin invariants by spanning-tree partitions and by the vertex recursion, c2 from Panzer–Yeats Theorem 1.8), period logs, and a Lean 4 / Mathlib proof of the Hepp/Martin incompatibility in which the large finite computations are evaluated with native_decide.
